howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play on the prototype, then click inside it once so it has the keys.
• Add: ⌥N (the browser keeps ⌘N), the + in the pane header, or click the empty space under a list's last task. The new task opens in the details with the cursor in its title. Return goes on to the notes; Esc is done. Left untitled, it's dropped.
• Rename: double-click a title, or select it and press Return. Lists too.
• Dates: select a task, ⌘S (When) or ⇧⌘D (Deadline), type tom, fri, 3d or nov 9, Return. Or click a chip.
• Drag rows to reorder, or onto a sidebar list to move them. Drag lists to reorder.
• Right-click rows and lists. ⌘Z undoes everything; delete, move and archive also show Undo.
• Press ? for every key.

starts_note.text:
Both boards start part-way through and are fully live.

Adding · ⌘N was just pressed in School: the new task's row sits at the bottom of the list, and its title is typed in the details but not saved yet. Click the title to keep typing; Return goes on to the notes, Esc finishes, clicking elsewhere saves it.

Dates · The When popover is open on a task in Today with "fri" typed. Arrows move the highlighted day, Return sets it, Esc closes.
